fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2025-09-01, the owner of Vetri Provision Store reported repeated demands for weekly payments of Rs. 2,200 from persons visiting the premises near Nila Puram Main Street in Ernakulam. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2025-08-31 at approximately 20:05. The complainant is associated with the business Vetri Provision Store. Vignesh Balan (9000000105), described as a driver, was also mentioned in the complaint. Abirami Raj (mobile 9000000141) was named as a possible person of interest. Potentially relevant material referenced includes a call detail reference.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Payment demands reportedly made with veiled threats.
fields.Keywords: extortion, business, associate, main street, mobile number, suspect, evening, call detail
